_comment: Coordinates reverse-engineered 2026-08-18 by word/image bounding-box extraction (template updated 2026-08-20: wording “200 hours” (dropped “more than”), body reflow; overlay coordinates unchanged) (pdfplumber + pymupdf) from 'IVY certificate - blank - v1.3.pdf' and the filled 'IVY certificate - sample.pdf' Bilal/Shahbaz shared. PDF coordinate convention: origin bottom-left, y_pt measured from page bottom (standard PDF/reportlab space) — pdfplumber's top-down 'top'/'bottom' values were converted via y_pt = page_height - center_of(top, bottom). x_pt/y_pt represent the anchor point per each field's 'anchor' (center fields use bbox center; left-anchored signature fields use the bbox's left edge, matching the underline they sit above). Fonts identified via embedded PDF font-subset names (CG = Cormorant Garamond, IN = Inter, GV = Great Vibes) and confirmed against the canonical files in github.com/google/fonts — all three are open-source (OFL), full family files vendored in fonts/ rather than the PDF's subsetted glyphs. signature_bilal/signature_olivia and certificate_id are NEW overlay field types beyond what lineage-engine's current cert_overlay.py renderer supports (butterfly-effect only needed recipient_name + date + qr) — wiring them up is PR3 in agentic_ai_context/plans/IVY_YOGA_COHORT_ONBOARDING_PLAN.md, gated on Gary's two open design decisions there. This config documents the target design now so PR3 has exact coordinates to implement against.
